## Motivation
Platform-agnostic bug fixes split out of #37698. Fixes #31995.

## Modifications
- `handle_dwdp`: reject `--dwdp-size >= 2` on non-NVIDIA platforms at arg resolution instead of failing later on the missing `cuda` bindings.
- `DeviceTimer`: resolve the device module once and become a no-op on devices without timing events (e.g. CPU); `metrics_reporter` skips the occupancy sample there instead of publishing 0.
- Scripted runtime: the root node's permanent `lock_ref` reads as 0; launch with `cuda_graph_backend_prefill="disabled"` (the old `disable_prefill_cuda_graph` kwarg is gone).
- Intel AMX CPU suites skip off-CI when the host lacks AMX; in CI they still fail loudly.
- Flux/ComfyUI: raise a clear error when pooled embeds are missing; back-fill text seq lens in the ComfyUI latent-prep stage, which has no text-encoding stage.

## Accuracy Tests
N/A. No kernel or numerics change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling
N/A. No hot-path change.

Unit tests: `TestDwdpPlatformGate` (3 passed), `test_scheduler_stage_metrics.py` (6 passed). `pre-commit` clean.

## Review history
Split from #37698; its commits are kept in this branch's history. Prior review threads: [comfyui_latent_preparation.py](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37698#discussion_r3921720047), [denoising.py](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37698#discussion_r4022783545), [parallel_hook.py](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37698#discussion_r4022783649), [metrics_reporter.py](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37698#discussion_r4245052727), [device_timer.py](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37698#discussion_r3921720006), [scripted_runtime/http_server.py](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37698#discussion_r3921720056), [test_utils.py](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37698#discussion_r3921719962).
